Name: Puffin Beach Farm
Author: Athelinda
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2732]Grass Growth[/url]A large map Beach Farm based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7038]Puffin Cove Farm[/url]﻿ by mops/starmops. I love the Puffin Cove Farm, but it is too tiny/cozy for my play style and definitely for multiplayer. So I set out to make a larger farm map based on it and moving it from Riverland to Beach (as it is clearly a beach farm). I still intend to improve it in the future.

This map replaces the Beach Farm. It has a large custom cave (make sure you don't use a custom cave on this farm else you will end up with just vanilla).

This farm map has approximately 3 times the tillable land in comparison with Puffin Cove, and has a custom (large) FarmCave. The area with the lighthouse is an animal area that animals can't leave. Good for either a coop and a barn or 2 barns.

My ToDo:
[list]
[*]Fishing at the beach should give ocean fish, still need to figure out if I can make that work.
[*]Make the use of the custom FarmCave configurable.
[*]Have the possibility to have the farm added as a new FarmType (like for example Waterfall Forest Farm does) instead of replacing the Beach Farm.
[*]Fix the water entrance at the beach, but something has gone wrong, thus I need to fix it.
[*]Adding more water troughs that work, right now the ones there are just decoration.
[*]Also want to add some functional benches. 
[*]Fix some aesthetics mostly in the fields (darker and lighter grass areas are not all pleasing to the eye).
[*]Make it so the surf sound can be optionally turned off in buildings.
[*]Maybe make it in the config that you can configure whether to have the lighthouse and/or animal fence.
[/list]
I am open to help in these areas.

Compatibility:
[list]
[*]I have no idea about compatibility with SVE, as it is not an extension I play.
[*]So far I have seen no conflicts with Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, LASV, and Stardew Valley Reimagined 2.
[/list]
Mod recommendations:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url]
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2732]Grass Growth[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1601]Winter Grass[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url]﻿﻿﻿

[/list]
With thanks to DaiyNiko for giving me some pointers.

I have permission from starmops (permission included in archive).
